$comment: Video placeholders and native-file outbound. videoPlaceholderCases: a route that cannot send video writes exactly one placeholder line per attached video, byte-identical on every end, mirroring the image placeholder of the same route in image-placeholder.v1.json with 'Image' replaced by 'Video'; no file name, no video block in the body; never silently dropped. separator: the user text and each placeholder line are joined with a blank line ('\n\n'), same on every end. A route that declares no image placeholder (it sends images natively, e.g. Anthropic Messages) uses the generic '[Video omitted: this route sends text only]'. nativeFileCases: on an official connection the native file part is sent only when the file_input projection says outbound=native_part; outbound=placeholder strips the native part and the file reaches the model through text injection - never a file placeholder line while text could be extracted. Each end names its tests MEDIA_OUTBOUND_<id> (Web: it('MEDIA-OUTBOUND-<id> ...')) and asserts the body from its production request builder.

videoPlaceholderCases.placeholder: [Video omitted: this route sends text only]
